item.text: {"explanation":"Memoize each evaluated node. A leaf update invalidates that leaf and every node reachable from it through dependency edges; unrelated memoized nodes remain valid. Evaluation recursively follows listed dependency order and counts only newly memoized nodes.","mapping":"The memo table is the retained state; dependency reachability maps leaf changes to invalidated computed values.","assumptions":"Inputs satisfy the stated DAG, node, and safe-integer constraints. State is only produced by this program.","applies":"function applies(input){return true}","holds":"function holds(input,output){var c=input.config, s={v:Object.assign({},c.values),m:{}}, want=[]; function inv(x){var q=[x],b={};while(q.length){var n=q.pop();if(b[n])continue;b[n]=1;for(var k in c.deps)if(c.deps[k].indexOf(n)>=0)q.push(k)}for(var k in b)delete s.m[k]} function ev(n){var count=0;function f(x){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.m,x))return s.m[x];var ds=c.deps[x],z;if(!ds.length)z=s.v[x];else{z=0;for(var i=0;i<ds.length;i++)z+=f(ds[i])}s.m[x]=z;count++;return z}var z=f(n),v=Object.keys(s.m).sort();return {value:z,computed:count,valid:v}}for(var i=0;i<input.events.length;i++){var e=input.events[i];if(e.type==='set'){if(c.deps[e.node].length===0){s.v[e.node]=e.value;inv(e.node)}want.push({value:null,computed:0,valid:Object.keys(s.m).sort()})}else want.push(ev(e.node))}return JSON.stringify(want)===JSON.stringify(output)}","program":"function solve({config,state,event}){var s=state||{v:Object.assign({},config.values),m:{}};if(event.type==='set'){if(config.deps[event.node].length===0){s.v[event.node]=event.value;var q=[event.node],bad={};while(q.length){var n=q.pop();if(bad[n])continue;bad[n]=1;for(var k in config.deps)if(config.deps[k].indexOf(n)>=0)q.push(k)}for(var k in bad)delete s.m[k]}return {state:s,output:{value:null,computed:0,valid:Object.keys(s.m).sort()}}}var count=0;function f(n){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(s.m,n))return s.m[n];var d=config.deps[n],z;if(!d.length)z=s.v[n];else{z=0;for(var i=0;i<d.length;i++)z+=f(d[i])}s.m[n]=z;count++;return z}var value=f(event.node);return {state:s,output:{value:value,computed:count,valid:Object.keys(s.m).sort()}}}"}
